title: Decrees of God
definition: The decrees of God are His eternal purposes by which He ordains all that comes to pass according to His wisdom, holiness, and glory.
summary: God's eternal purposes are wise, holy, and certain.
christFocus: Christ stands at the center of God's eternal saving purpose, accomplishing redemption according to the Father's plan.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The decrees of God speak of His eternal purposes. God does not react in surprise to history. He works all things according to the counsel of His will.

This doctrine must be handled with reverence. God's decrees do not make Him evil, nor do they remove human responsibility. Scripture holds together God's sovereignty and meaningful human action.

The cross is the clearest example: human evil was real, yet God's saving purpose stood behind redemption in Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People often think life is ruled by chance, chaos, or human power. The decrees of God matter because they teach that history is under God's wise and holy purpose.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Let this truth produce worship, humility, and confidence rather than speculation. Trust God's purposes, obey His commands, and rest in Christ when providence is hard to understand.
